title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a pharmaceutical compiler keeps naming identity, practical replacement and recipe membership as three different relations
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Instead of fitting one ingredient co-occurrence graph, jointly author a small pharmaceutical account in which two names denote one material, a different material can replace it when unavailable, and a recipe contains an actual selected material. A single shared writing grammar must preserve these different relations across complete records. No Voynich word or drug is assigned.

design.production_mechanism: A compiler turns several functional sections of a pharmacopoeia into a compact shared notation. The same drug vocabulary recurs in an illustrated simples section, synonym lists, replacement instructions and recipes, but the operations on that vocabulary differ. This is a proposed whole-book organization, not a claim that Voynich copies the comparator.

historical_supply.catalogue_sections: Tractatus de herbis ff1r-106v; Antidotarium Nicolai ff112r-124v; substitution list for unavailable ingredients ff125v-127r; synonyms for plant names and medical ingredients ff128v-146r.
historical_supply.claim_limit: Institutional catalogue establishes coexistence and functions, not any newly transcribed common drug or complete cross-section triple. No assertion of conditional nontransitivity, composite substitution, or a specific witness is made from the catalogue alone. Native collation would be a source task, not manuscript translation. Web secondary/AI-looking comparisons were not used as evidence.

existing_positive_exploited: GDT608: ordered components and exact whole forms both carry information; relation-bearing constructions cannot be collapsed into unordered ingredient sets.

GDT915: familiar two-form phrase families covary across leaves, allowing a restricted candidate inventory for a shared construction rather than an unrestricted word permutation. Mixed cells and GDT916 nontransfer remain.
Cross-section adjacency transfer in the structural baseline makes a shared writer worth considering, without establishing one uniform semantic register.
design.finite_construction: NAME(a,b,M); UNAVAILABLE(M) licenses REPLACE(M,N); RECIPE(R,[M,P]) has an alternative realization [N,P]. M and N remain distinct substances; a and b denote the same M. All names, predicates and correspondence to written groups remain latent. This is a finite joint content hypothesis, not an assignment to a particular native passage.
design.unequal_consequence: A naming-identity reading predicts that resolving a versus b leaves ingredient identity and participant count unchanged in every linked record. A replacement reading permits a different ingredient identity under its written guard while preserving the other recipe participants. A co-ingredient reading requires both material participants in one recipe realization. These alternatives cannot all be satisfied merely by renaming a graph's nodes if the same candidate writer must also express the guard and the complete recipe realization. Absence of an ingredient name alone does not count as a written exclusion.
design.smallest_next_step: Shortlist a single already-owned complete recipe-like record and its existing repeated construction contexts, then attempt all three finite accounts together with one bounded grammar and explicit unknowns. Do not create a fresh target census or fit a generic graph. In parallel, a source-only read of one complete Egerton substitution entry and its linked synonym/recipe records would establish whether the comparator actually supplies the joint contrast. Do not assume exact repeated words or a known translated anchor are prerequisites for drafting; pay any variation rule explicitly.
design.frequency_contract: No frequent form receives a drug name or operator gloss here. Before any concrete assignment, retrieve every nominated exact-form profile and prior counterexamples; account for all occurrences of the proposed shared construction, including repetitions and nonmedical sections. Do not pool standalone and embedded strings or readers.
likely_failures: The relevant native constructions may not recur in linked complete units, leaving the three accounts observationally equivalent.
A freely configurable guard or ingredient-identity map would make this another relabelling exercise; those freedoms must be bounded before selection.
Names can be genuinely polysemous and medieval substitutions can be reciprocal. Do not assume a nontransitive or asymmetric substitution graph without source evidence.
A source-relative graph may have automorphisms; successful relation typing would still not identify particular drugs.
nearest_predecessors: IDEA000707 already owns a local obligatory-ingredient versus permitted-substitute contrast. This proposal is retained only for the additional cross-record naming-identity constraint; a one-recipe implementation would duplicate707.

GDT1159 fixed anonymous commodity co-occurrence recovery failed. This proposal cannot alter its score or repair its weight scheme; explicit naming and replacement relations would be genuinely different inputs.
GDT910 literal short/long substitution found no recurrent rule. No identical-flank expansion or new literal decoder is assumed.
IDEA000511 and GDT1031 guessed synonym shortening remain unchanged; the proposal does not inherit their synonym sets.
GDT1165 remains numerically invalid with worse descriptive inversion gain; no q=NOT promotion or image-frequency repair.
design.duplicate_screen: Route and composition topic read. Bounded ideas searches on substitute medicines, synonym substitution list, nontransitive substitution, replacement mixture and succedaneis; route-check substitution synonym compound remedy. This is an unreviewed distinction, not a novelty verdict from empty lexical hits.

existing_complete_units_considered: IDEA000370 preserves the complete written lines f21r.12 and f32v.10 with a repeated chor chol daiin phrase; the file research_registry/proposals/raw_shared_ingredient_goal_contract.json contains both exact lines and its earlier speculative lexicon. These are complete lines, not complete paragraphs, and the inherited FLOWERS/DRY/AMOUNT values are not lexical facts.

GDT1129 preserves the complete f75v.38-42 packet: experiments/yolo/gdt1129_whole_reciprocal_relation_description/REPORT.md and its A/B_READING artifacts. The reciprocal construction alone does not establish naming or substitution. Its expensive complete symbolic account and post-freeze hybrid remain live limitations.
target_packet_review_after_retention.decision: Neither packet currently instantiates all three proposed relation types. Do not start a new test by simply replacing the old FLOWERS or directional glosses with drug names. This card is raw supply, not a claimed executable native contrast. A newly authored joint account may be attempted without confirmed meanings, but it must first expose actual written differences between identity, replacement and membership across its complete units.

design.access: No target queries, images, reserves, fits, contacts or manuscript admissions. Only existing reports/registry and public historical catalogue/OCR navigation.
